EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
This employment contract is made between Pwani Logistics Limited (the Employer) and Brian Ochieng Otieno (the Employee).
1. Position
The Employee is employed as a forklift operator at the Employer's Changamwe depot, Mombasa, with effect from 1st February 2019.
2. Probation
The first three (3) months of employment shall be a probation period.
3. Remuneration
The Employee shall be paid a gross salary of KES 32,000 per month, subject to statutory deductions (PAYE, NSSF, SHIF and the Housing Levy).
4. Hours and leave
Normal working hours are 45 hours per week. The Employee is entitled to 21 working days of annual leave.
5. Notice
After confirmation, either party may end this contract by giving 30 days' written notice or paying salary in lieu.

For the Employer
____________________
Employee
